steps.name: The Sword Master's Test (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jin] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters", then defeat [Randine] in the "Hall of Heroes" and obtain a <Disillusionment Magic Stone>. Afterward, find [Pulse] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What did you want to tell me?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You look worried. As promised, I haven't told anyone you met Weiss.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The Sword Master seems to know, though. I heard him remark to himself that you've already obtained traces of three Champions' power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Champions must have sensed something. Shynic in Tartaros and Medea in Kali both spoke as if they already knew...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't know about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When can I see Ziskad? I think I need to receive a trace of his power...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: He'll probably summon you soon. Please wait a little longer. The Sword Master is away investigating something at the moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose it can't be helped...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Iris isn't here. She did tell me not to visit Lumen too often...)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Lady Iris isn't here right now. Lately, she's been spending most of her time in the Illusory Poison Mist Swamp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like you just read my mind.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Enough of that. Let's get to the point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The Sword Master needs a few things before he meets you. I want you to obtain them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's testing me, isn't he?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Probably. Before accepting someone, the Sword Master judges their potential. His disciples and I all went through the same process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I bring, then?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Find magic stones in Tartaros's Hall of Heroes and leave them with the mage there. He needs two.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You defeated Randine, the man who took over the Hall of Heroes, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't think that means you won't be able to find them. The Sword Master says you can see places hidden from sight...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'm not sure I understand, but I'll manage somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's no point keeping secrets when everyone already knows about me...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else after I deliver them?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The mage will explain. That's all I know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

steps.name: The Sword Master's Test (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Hostile Tractus] in the "Divine Tree Lapier" and obtain an <Illusion Tree Seed>. Then find [Tia] in the "Amaloon Desert".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doesn't notice when someone arrives, again. It's hardly the first time...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, you're here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found the items. Here...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: So these are the magic stones that brainwashed Randine. Their effects have surely worn off by now...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: In any case, I'll analyze them as the Alliance requested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to ask. What can you learn by analyzing these magic stones?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I can't say yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know lots of people are studying the Deimos cult's magic stones. But no one seems to have come up with a proper answer.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: We conduct our analyses, and they conduct theirs. Each faction will put its findings to use in its own way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: The reason we lack a definitive answer is... The magic stones made by the Deimos cult keep evolving into different forms.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Previously, they were made by extracting life force and used to brainwash other living beings. Recently, we've found some things that are hard to believe.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Please understand that I can't explain properly until we're certain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I know how difficult your work is, Adventurer, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But...?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I hope you don't lose sight of yourself. This may be coming from a mage with poor people skills, but I don't think it's bad advice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Pulse. What should I do next?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I don't know where to find them, but please obtain some Illusion Tree Seeds and give them to someone named Tia in the Amaloon Desert. About fifty should do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is she going to plant them in the desert...?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I couldn't say... Only she knows. Now, I must return to my research...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... Illusion Tree Seeds. Back to Lapier, then.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. It's good to see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here are the things you requested...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I was waiting for something Yuran said she would send from Lumen. So this is it.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Both Lumen and the neighboring Kingdom of Jude have allowed me to stay here, so I wanted to make a few improvements.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, what are these seeds called?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Illusion Tree Seeds. They come from trees that only grow on sacred ground.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sacred creatures called phantom beasts carry and scatter these special seeds.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: How fascinating. That reminds me of my little ones...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Exactly. Maybe that's why they all dislike me and keep biting me.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: That's proof they love you. These seeds... I can sense someone extraordinary in them. Have you met a new god?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain what has happened to Tia.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The god who created the land of this world... They have been through much. And so have you, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: And those who coveted power met an end much like my younger sibling's... Perhaps that was inevitable...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you need anything else? Something I should find and take somewhere...?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: No, nothing like that. I think you should simply return to Lumen and hear what Yuran has to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wonder what Yuran wants to tell me...)

steps.name: The Sword Master's Test (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jin] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters" and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You've been busy. It feels like a long time since I last saw you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I know you've encountered various strange phenomena and met Weiss. Thank you for helping with matters in the Amaloon Desert, too.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You've helped us so often. As a member of the Alliance, I thank you once again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems to be treating me differently...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You needn't be suspicious. I speak as a member of the Alliance and a disciple of my master...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And thank you, as always, for looking after Ull.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't see Ull here. Off training again, I take it?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes. That's how he is... Enough pleasantries. My master left a message for you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He asks you to wait. He'll speak to you about a certain relic soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A relic...?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I don't know what it is, but it seems it will soon serve an important purpose for our Alliance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, there are a lot of people here. Is something happening?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Following the campaign against the Kingdom of Moss, we agreed to expand our ties with the Silvaria Empire in Freios.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Some members of the Silvaria Empire have stayed behind to attend to business. Phobos isn't too pleased about it, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phobos? Where's that?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: A small city in northwestern Eastland. We have little contact because it's so far away, but the Deimos cult has less influence there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You may visit when the time comes. We've heard the Fierce King is staying nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phobos...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Yuran, have you finished?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: %s, come over here. I still have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer, I have work to do, so I'll excuse myself. Please speak with Jin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Yuran. Take care.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You handled the Sword Master's requests well. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing... What did you want to tell me?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It seems the Silvaria Empire has made progress in its investigation based on Mara's testimony.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This came up during her interrogation: Mara admitted she was a fake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fake Agasura... It was strange, certainly. Joining forces with the Kingdom of Moss and wreaking havoc everywhere to build a kingdom for Agasuras...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At least, that's not how the Agasuras I know behave.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Exactly. Ordinary Agasuras don't run around causing trouble with magic stones. I'll continue.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Ban and Mara received the power to make magic stones from Weiss. That led them to believe they were Agasuras.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Mara told the Silvaria Empire this herself. Some of the information was shared with us.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: She said Weiss killed Ban. But she seemed to have forgotten that you were there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Weiss do something...?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Possibly. It was probably an Agasura's contract...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you knew they were fakes...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Mara told them everything. Weiss could have altered her memories to keep even that secret, but he didn't.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: He must be scheming something.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: In any case, what Ban and Mara were doing was no different from Weiss and the Deimos cult's activities. You already know that, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The evidence we've gathered has cleared up many of our suspicions. The power of the magic stones—or, more precisely, the power Weiss has been gathering...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It's all heading toward Avalon. The place everyone in Eastland curses...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Avalon is where Frozen, the Demigod, said he'd gone... The capital of the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos...)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: One day, you and all of us may have to go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Farther north than Lumen. This has lifted a great burden from us. All that remains now is them and the fiends of the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The fakes have done so much damage to this land.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It isn't over yet. We'll keep working until then. We'll be counting on you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I'll be counting on you. I'll go take care of the rest of my business now.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: May fortune favor you, %s...
